items.title: Theodore Purnell Interview, 1972-06-16
items.q: When we went to Chicago, cook was with us, cook was with us then.

ctx.x: Would they ever make any jokes? Huh? Make any jokes? Make any jokes. The MC, would he make jokes? Would he be a comic?

Yeah, yeah. No, no. Yeah, he'd use his kicks, man. Yeah? Yeah. Did you ever work with Sherman Cook? Yeah. Sherman Cook, yeah. Used to be around the store, you know? Oh, yeah? Sure, man. He was MCY. Where was he from? What?
Was he from away or was he from New Orleans or what? I don't know where Cook was from. I know he died.
